name: Knight · Black Knight
description: A brooding little tyrant in jagged obsidian plate: a closed helm with two curved horns and two glowing red eyes in its visor slit, spiky pauldrons, a tattered blood-red cloak that streams behind him, and a jagged greatsword held up before him in both hands, its edge a glowing red saw. He walks with the blade rocking, cloak flapping; his cut swings it back, brings it over in a dark-red crescent, slams it down and lifts it to guard again.
